study: Knudsen KS et al. Whole genome sequencing of the pulmonary microbiome in interstitial lung disease subtypes. Respiratory Research 2025;26:324. DOI:10.1186/s12931-025-03404-5; PMCID:PMC12628550
host_depletion_provenance: No wet-lab host-depletion protocol reported. The paper reports high human contamination and computational removal of taxa under phylum Chordata before bacterial OTU identification; deposited read state is unavailable.
scientific_value: Potentially valuable cohort-specific healthy-reference lower-airway ecology study, but public data availability and parent-study confounding prevent a reproducible cross-cohort/common-Kraken2 analysis at this time.
major_blockers: Dryad target remains explicitly private for peer review; no released dataset DOI or public file manifest was located.
No public deterministic sample/run/BioSample to clinical-group mapping.
Parent study is perfectly aligned with healthy versus disease status.
Sequencing batch and per-sample technical metadata are not public.
overall_verdict: CONDITIONAL_PARK: do not process or harmonize until a released data manifest and deterministic sample-group mapping are available.
